tei:div.tei:p: Be gracious to us, O Lord, be gracious; answer us, O Lord, answer us; help us, God of our salvation, for we rest on thee. (Help us, &c.)help us, God of our salvation, for we rest on thee.

In battle, some trust in their chiefs, and some in their horses,Compare Ps. xx. 8. but we will venture in thy holy name; thou, who dwellest in heaven, wilt appear to save us. (Help us, &c.)help us, God of our salvation, for we rest on thee.

Some glory in their legions, and some in their pomp, but we will prevail by the aid of him who is mighty in salvation, and helpeth abundantly those who are powerless. (Help us, &c.)help us, God of our salvation, for we rest on thee.

Some
trust in their shields, and some in their bucklers; but we raise thy word as our protection, it is a refuge to us from the blast of the terrible ones. (Help us, &c.)help us, God of our salvation, for we rest on thee.

Some trust in their neighing, stamping chargers, and some in their dazzling swords and sheltering cloaks; but we trust in him who covereth himself with light as with a garment, who contemptuously spurneth their highest leaders. (Help us, &c.)help us, God of our salvation, for we rest on thee.

Some trust in their close cuirasses, and some in their serried ranks; but we arm ourselves with confidence in the protector of those who trust in him, and who humbleth the pride of the haughty. (Help us, &c.)help us, God of our salvation, for we rest on thee.

Some trust in their noisy horns, and some in their loud war cries; but we trust in him whose voice stilleth the noise of the waters, and rendeth and dasheth to pieces dry rocks. (Help us, &c.)help us, God of our salvation, for we rest on thee.

Some trust in their stratagems, some in their battle array, but we in the Incomparable, who raiseth the disheartened, and maketh them tread upon the high places of their adversaries. (Help us, &c.)help us, God of our salvation, for we rest on thee.

Some trust in their victories, and some in their murderous weapons; but we spread our hands in the name of the Strength of Israel, and every anxiety, and fear, and despondency, vanisheth. (Be gracious, &c.)Be gracious to us, O Lord, be gracious; answer us, O Lord, answer us; help us, God of our salvation, for we rest on thee.
